summary: New Jersey law firm Greenbaum, Rowe, Smith & Davis, which represents major health systems, had an intrusion through a compromised user account on November 25-27, 2025. Names, addresses, medical record numbers, medical history, provider details, bill amounts and insurance information of 12,801 patients of Hackensack Meridian Health, Atlantic Health and Trinitas Regional Medical Center were exposed; some also had SSNs or dates of birth exposed. It found no evidence the data was published or misused.
